snippet.title: Coney's | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time for your first day of work at Coney’s! An ice cream parlor that specializes in cones! Bake cones! Scoop ice cream! Serve with a smile! And at the end of your shift, don’t forget to clean up the store before you head home! Nothing bad will happen 🍦

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4223000/Coneys/
